:::{#thm-alt-cov}
#### Alternative formula for covariance

$$\Cov{X,Y}= \E{XY} - \E{X} \E{Y}$$

:::

::: proof

Let $\mean_X = \E{X}$ and $\mean_Y = \E{Y}$ be the [population means](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) of $X$ and $Y$.
They are constants, so [linearity of expectation](expectation.qmd#thm-linearity-expectation) applies with them as coefficients,
analogous to the proof of the [simplified expression for variance](#thm-variance):

$$
\ba
\Cov{X,Y}
&\eqdef \E{(X-\mean_X)(Y-\mean_Y)} && \text{(definition of covariance, with population means } \mean_X, \mean_Y \text{)} \\
&= \E{XY - X\mean_Y - Y\mean_X + \mean_X\mean_Y} && \text{(expand the product)} \\
&= \E{XY} - \mean_Y\E{X} - \mean_X\E{Y} + \mean_X\mean_Y && \text{(linearity of expectation; } \mean_X, \mean_Y \text{ are constants)} \\
&= \E{XY} - \mean_Y\mean_X - \mean_X\mean_Y + \mean_X\mean_Y && \text{(} \E{X} = \mean_X \text{ and } \E{Y} = \mean_Y \text{)} \\
&= \E{XY} - \mean_X\mean_Y && \text{(combine like terms)} \\
&= \E{XY} - \E{X}\E{Y} && \text{(} \mean_X = \E{X} \text{ and } \mean_Y = \E{Y} \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
